decisions.reason: As a flagship line close to the firm's core glass packaging capabilities and still present after launch, it likely meets at least minimum aspirations or is protected by the firm's current growth and investment slack, so management would keep it.

Although newer and therefore less proven, it is a strategically highlighted extension of the firm's established technology base in a growing R&D-intensive market, and the firm's expansionary position gives management room to continue carrying it while results become clearer.
